packets.title: S010 Yunus CP01 vv001-020
paragraphs: Unit: 10:1–20 (20 verses). Meccan by traditional label.
Basmala returns. 9:111 find-test stays parked with 7:157.

Alif Lām Rā. Those are the signs of the wise Book. Was it a wonder to people that We revealed to a man from among them: warn the people, and give good news to those who believe that they have a true footing with their Lord? The unbelievers say: this is a clear sorcerer.

Your Lord is God who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then sat upon the Throne, directing the affair. There is no intercessor except after His leave. That is God, your Lord, so worship Him. Will you not remember? To Him is your return, all of you. God’s promise is true. He begins creation then repeats it, to recompense those who believed and did righteous deeds with justice. Those who disbelieved will have a drink of boiling water and a painful punishment for what they disbelieved.

He is the one who made the sun a glow and the moon a light, and determined for it stations, that you may know the number of years and the reckoning. God created that only with the truth. He details the signs for a people who know. In the alternation of night and day, and what God created in the heavens and the earth, are signs for a people who fear.

Those who do not expect Our meeting and are pleased with this world’s life and at rest in it, and who are heedless of Our signs — those, their refuge is the Fire for what they have been earning. Those who believe and do righteous deeds — their Lord guides them by their faith. Rivers flow beneath them in gardens of bliss. Their call there: glory to You, God. Their greeting there: peace. Their last call: praise to God, Lord of the worlds.

If God were to hasten the evil for people as they would hasten the good, their term would have been concluded. So We leave those who do not expect Our meeting wandering in their excess. When harm touches man he calls Us on his side or sitting or standing. When We remove the harm from him he passes on as if he had not called Us to a harm that touched him. What they do is made fair to the extravagant.

We destroyed generations before you when they did wrong, and their messengers came to them with the clear signs, and they were not to believe. So We recompense the criminal people. Then We made you successors in the land after them, to see how you would act.

When Our signs are recited to them as clear signs, those who do not expect Our meeting say: bring a Quran other than this, or change it. Say: it is not for me to change it of my own accord. I follow only what is revealed to me. I fear, if I disobey my Lord, the punishment of a great day. Say: if God had willed I would not have recited it to you, and He would not have made it known to you. I had already stayed among you a lifetime before it. Will you not understand? Who does more wrong than one who forges a lie against God or calls His signs a lie? The criminals will not prosper.

They worship besides God what does not harm them and does not benefit them, and they say: these are our intercessors with God. Say: will you inform God of what He does not know in the heavens or in the earth? Glory to Him, high above what they associate. The people were only one community, then they differed. If a prior word from your Lord had not gone forth, it would have been decided between them in what they differ. They say: why has a sign not been sent down on him from his Lord? Say: the unseen is only God’s. So wait. I am with you among those who wait.

1–2 letters; wonder that a man from them is sent; they say sorcerer. 3–6 six days, Throne, no intercessor except after leave; sun and moon stations; night and day. 7–10 two ends: no meeting vs gardens. 11–12 if evil were hastened; man calls in harm then forgets. 13–14 destroyed generations; you are successors. 15–17 bring another Quran or change it — I cannot change it of my own; I follow what is revealed; I stayed a lifetime before it; forging is the greater wrong. 18–20 intercessors that neither harm nor benefit; one community then they differed; why no sign; the unseen is God’s; wait.

Created heavens and earth in six days, then istawā ʿalā l-ʿarsh, directing the affair. No intercessor except after His leave. Cousin of 7:54 already walked. Genesis-creation comparison file remains living; do not rebuild it here.

Bring a Quran other than this, or change it. Say: it is not mine to change it of my own accord (min tilqāʾi nafsī). I follow only what is revealed to me. I fear, if I disobey my Lord, a great day’s punishment. If God had willed I would not have recited it; He would not have made it known to you. I stayed among you a lifetime before it. Who does more wrong than one who forges against God.

This is the parked cousin now walked. It belongs on Pole B of the authority frame (QB-0269): he does not manufacture or edit the Recitation. 7:203 was the no-sign-on-demand verse. 10:15 is the no-edit verse. 9:43 remains the correctable-discretion verse. Three different limits.

They worship what neither harms nor benefits and call them intercessors with God. Will you inform God of what He does not know? People were one community, then differed. A prior word from your Lord postponed the decision. Why has no sign been sent down on him? The unseen is only God’s. Wait. I wait with you. Unseen-limit restates 7:188.

SI: of my own accord. Haleem: on my own. Pickthall: of my own accord. Arberry: of my own accord.
No split. He cannot rewrite the Recitation from himself.

His pre-revelation years among them are the argument.

A man from them is the wonder; they call it sorcery. Six-day creation and Throne-direction; no intercessor except after leave. Two ends: no-meeting / gardens. Harm-prayer then forgetfulness. Destroyed generations; you are successors. He cannot change the Recitation from himself; he follows what is revealed; forging is the greater wrong; he lived among them a lifetime before it. Claimed intercessors neither harm nor benefit. The unseen is God’s; wait for the sign.

packets.title: S010 Yunus CP02 vv021-040
paragraphs: When We let people taste mercy after a harm has touched them, they plot against Our signs. Say: God is swifter in plotting. Our messengers write what you plot.

He is the one who makes you travel in the land and the sea. When you are in the ships and they run with them by a good wind and they rejoice in it, a storm-wind comes on them and waves come on them from every place and they think they are encompassed. They call on God, making the religion purely His: if You save us from this we will surely be of the thankful. When He saves them, they rebel in the earth without right. O people, your rebellion is only against yourselves — enjoyment of this world’s life. Then to Us is your return and We will tell you what you used to do.

The likeness of this world’s life is like water We sent down from the sky, so the plants of the earth mixed with it that people and cattle eat, until when the earth has taken its ornament and is decked and its people think they have power over it, Our command comes on it by night or day and We make it a mown harvest as if it had not flourished yesterday. So We detail the signs for a people who reflect. God calls to the home of peace and guides whom He wills to a straight path. For those who did good, the good and more. Neither dust nor humiliation covers their faces. Those are the companions of the Garden, abiding. Those who earned evil — the recompense of an evil is the like of it, and humiliation covers them. They have no defender from God. As if their faces were covered with strips of night, dark. Those are the companions of the Fire, abiding.

The day We gather them all, then We say to those who associated: stay in your place, you and your partners. We will separate them. Their partners will say: you were not worshipping us. God is sufficient as witness between us and you. We were of your worship unaware. There every soul will prove what it did before. They will be returned to God their true mawlā. What they used to invent will stray from them.

Say: who provides for you from the sky and the earth? Or who owns hearing and sight? Who brings out the living from the dead and the dead from the living? Who directs the affair? They will say: God. Say: will you not then fear? That is God, your true Lord. What is there after the truth except error? How then are you turned? So the word of your Lord is realized against those who are wicked, that they will not believe. Say: is there among your partners one who begins creation then repeats it? Say: God begins creation then repeats it. How then are you turned? Say: is there among your partners one who guides to the truth? Say: God guides to the truth. Is one who guides to the truth worthier to be followed, or one who does not guide unless he is guided? What is the matter with you? How do you judge? Most of them follow only conjecture. Conjecture does not avail against the truth anything. God knows what they do.

This Quran could not have been produced apart from God, but it is a confirmation of what is before it and a detailing of the Book — there is no doubt in it — from the Lord of the worlds. Or do they say: he has forged it? Say: bring a sūra like it, and call whom you can besides God, if you are truthful. No: they have denied what they did not encompass in knowledge, and whose interpretation has not yet come to them. So those before them denied. See how the end of the wrongdoers was. Among them are those who believe in it, and among them those who do not believe in it. Your Lord knows the workers of corruption best.

21 plot after mercy. 22–23 ships, storm, pure call, then rebellion. 24 dunya as vegetation then mown. 25–27 home of peace vs evil repaid in kind. 28–30 partners disown the worshippers. 31–36 provider / hearing / living-from-dead; they say God; after truth only error; partners cannot begin creation or guide. 37 this Quran not produced apart from God; confirmation of what is before it; detailing of the Book. 38 challenge: a sūra like it. 39 they deny what they have not encompassed. 40 some believe, some do not.

Mercy after harm produces plotting against signs. Sea-voyage: good wind, then storm, a pure call, then rebellion once saved. This-world likeness: water, ornamented earth, then a command, mown as if it never flourished. God calls to dār al-salām. Good gets the good and more; evil gets its like.

Gathered, the partners say: you were not worshipping us; we were unaware. Every soul proves what it sent ahead. Provider, hearing and sight, living from dead, director of the affair — they will say God. After truth, error. Partners neither begin creation nor guide to truth. Most follow conjecture.

This Quran could not be produced apart from God. It is a confirmation (taṣdīq) of what is between its hands / before it (mā bayna yadayhi) and a detailing of the Book. Or they say he forged it: bring a sūra like it, and call whom you can besides God.

Taṣdīq mā bayna yadayhi is the walked confirmation-formula (already 2:41, 3:3, 5:48). It treats prior revelation as something this Recitation confirms, not as scrap. That sits on the tahrif snapshot and the 7:157 / 9:111 witness-file: you do not confirm a book that is not there. 10:38 is the like-sūra challenge (cousin of 2:23, 11:13 parked). Level 1 is the challenge, not a completed literary experiment.
yamkurūna fī āyātinā. fī l-fulk. dār al-salām. shurakāʾ. yaqḍī l-ḥaqq. ẓann. mā kāna hādhā l-Qurʾānu an yuftarā. taṣdīqa lladhī bayna yadayhi. tafṣīla l-kitāb. bi-sūratin mithlihi.
SI: a confirmation of what was before it. Haleem: confirmation of what was revealed before it. Pickthall: a confirmation of what was before it. Arberry: confirming what was before it.
bayna yadayhi = between its hands / before it. Standard confirmation-formula.

SI: a detailed explanation of the [former] Scripture. Haleem: a detailed explanation of the Scripture. Pickthall: an exposition of that which is decreed for mankind. Arberry: a distinguishing of the Book.
SI inserts 'former.' Arabic is detailing of the Book.
SI: a surah like it. Haleem: a single surah like it. Pickthall: a surah like it. Arberry: a sura like it.
One sura. Challenge, not a scored contest in this verse.
Yusuf Ali 10:37 line only: 'a confirmation of (revelations) that went before it, and a fuller explanation of the Book.'

Mercy can produce plotting. Deliverance can produce rebellion. This life is ornament then mown field. Partners will disown their worshippers. They already know who provides. This Recitation is presented as unforgeable-apart-from-God, as confirmation of what is before it, and as detailing of the Book. The forge-charge is answered with a like-sūra challenge. Denial can precede understanding.

packets.title: S010 Yunus CP03 vv041-056
paragraphs: If they deny you, say: I have my work and you have your work. You are quit of what I do and I am quit of what you do.

Among them are those who listen to you. Can you make the deaf hear, even though they do not understand? Among them are those who look at you. Can you guide the blind, even though they do not see? God does not wrong people anything. But people wrong themselves.

The day He gathers them as if they had not stayed except an hour of the day, they will recognize one another. Those who denied the meeting of God have lost, and they were not guided. Whether We show you some of what We promise them or We take you, to Us is their return. Then God is witness over what they do.

Every community has a messenger. When their messenger comes, it is decided between them with justice, and they are not wronged. They say: when is this promise, if you are truthful? Say: I do not possess for myself harm or benefit except what God wills. Every community has a term. When their term comes they will not delay an hour or go forward.

Say: have you seen if His punishment comes to you by night or day — what of it would the criminals seek to hasten? Then, when it falls, will you believe in it? Now? And you were seeking to hasten it. Then it will be said to those who did wrong: taste the punishment of the lasting. Are you recompensed except for what you used to earn?

They ask you: is it true? Say: yes, by my Lord, it is true. You will not frustrate. If every soul that did wrong had what is in the earth, it would ransom itself with it. They will hide regret when they see the punishment. It will be decided between them with justice, and they will not be wronged. To God belongs what is in the heavens and the earth. God’s promise is true. But most of them do not know. He gives life and causes death, and to Him you will be returned.

41 work-split: I am quit of yours, you of mine. 42–44 listeners who do not hear; lookers who do not see; God does not wrong. 45–46 gathered as an hour; whether some promised punishment is shown to you or you are taken. 47 every ummah a messenger; then it is decided justly. 48–49 when is the promise; I possess neither harm nor benefit except what God wills; every ummah a term. 50–52 if the punishment comes; will you believe then. 53 is it true — yes by my Lord. 54–56 ransom of the earth would not avail; to God what is in the heavens; He gives life and death.

If they deny you: my work, your work. You are bariʾ of what I do; I of what you do. Cousin of 9:1 baraʾa, different job: here a work-split after denial, not a compact-quit. Pole-adjacent: he is not made the owner of their account.

Likulli ummatin rasūl. When their messenger comes, it is decided between them with justice. The pattern is ummah-by-ummah, messenger-by-messenger, then a just decision. Does not, in this verse, name the content of each message.

I do not possess for myself ḍarr or nafʿ except what God wills. Every ummah has an ajal. When it comes they neither delay nor advance an hour. This is 7:188 walked again, same limit, now next to the ummah-term. Pole B thickened.

They ask: is it true? Yes, by my Lord. You will not frustrate. The oath is on the promised hour / punishment of this stretch, not a new book-claim.

packets.title: S010 Yunus CP04 vv057-070
paragraphs: O people, an admonition has come to you from your Lord, and a healing for what is in the breasts, and a guidance and a mercy for the believers. Say: in the bounty of God and in His mercy — in that let them rejoice. It is better than what they gather.

Say: have you seen what God has sent down for you of provision, then you made some of it forbidden and some lawful? Say: did God give you leave, or do you invent against God? What do those who invent the lie against God think of the Last Day? God is full of bounty to the people, but most of them are not thankful.

You are not in any affair, nor do you recite any of it from a Quran, nor do you do any deed, except that We are over you witnesses when you are engaged in it. Not an atom’s weight in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from your Lord, nor smaller than that or greater, except it is in a clear book.

The friends of God — no fear on them, nor do they grieve: those who believed and were godfearing. For them good news in this world’s life and in the last. There is no changing the words of God. That is the great triumph. Let not their speech grieve you. The might belongs to God, all of it. He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

To God belongs whoever is in the heavens and whoever is in the earth. Those who call besides God on partners follow only conjecture, and they only guess. He is the one who made the night for you to rest in it and the day to see. In that are signs for a people who hear.

They said: God has taken a son. Glory to Him. He is the Free, the Rich. To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is in the earth. You have no authority for this. Do you say against God what you do not know? Say: those who invent the lie against God will not prosper. Enjoyment in this world, then to Us is their return, then We will make them taste the harsh punishment for what they disbelieved.

57–58 admonition, healing of breasts, guidance, mercy; rejoice in bounty and mercy. 59–60 they split provision into ḥarām and ḥalāl — God’s leave or invention? 61 no affair / recitation / deed except We witness; not an atom hidden. 62–64 awliyāʾ Allāh: no fear, no grief; good news here and next; no changing God’s words. 65 do not let their speech grieve you; the ʿizza is God’s. 66–67 partners are conjecture; night and day. 68–70 God has taken a son — glory; He is ghaniyy; no authority for this; inventors will not prosper.

The coming thing is named mawʿiẓa, shifāʾ for what is in the breasts, hudā, raḥma. Rejoice in bounty and mercy rather than in what is gathered. Then: provision God sent down — you made some forbidden, some lawful. Did God give leave, or do you invent against God? Inventing ḥarām/ḥalāl without leave is the charge. Last Day is the test-question put to the inventors.

No affair you are in, no Quran you recite from it, no deed, except We are witnesses while you are in it. Not a speck in earth or heaven hidden — nor smaller nor greater — except in a clear book. Friends of God: believed, feared; no fear, no grief; good news in both lives. There is no changing the words of God (lā tabdīla li-kalimāti llāh). Same tabdīl-root family as 10:15 baddilhu, different object: His words will not be substituted. Do not collapse this into a muṣḥaf-history claim without saying so.
10:68 they said God has taken a son

Qālū ttakhadha llāhu waladan. Glory. He is al-ghaniyy. To Him what is in the heavens and the earth. You have no sulṭān for this. Do you say against God what you do not know? Inventors of the lie will not prosper. Enjoyment, then return, then harsh punishment.

The speakers are not named as Jews or Christians in this verse. Walked Christology file (4:171, 5:17, 9:30) already attaches ‘son’ to Christians (and ʿUzayr to Jews). 10:68 is the generic taken-a-son charge. Do not force a speaker-label the verse does not write. Apply 10:36: the claim is still historically testable.
mawʿiẓa. shifāʾ. ḥarramtum / ḥalālan. taftarūna. mithqāla dharratin. awliyāʾ Allāh. lā tabdīla li-kalimāti llāh. al-ʿizza. ẓann / yakhrusūn. ittakhadha llāhu waladan. al-ghaniyy. sulṭān.
SI: healing for what is in the breasts. Haleem: healing for what is in the heart. Pickthall: healing for that which is in the breasts. Arberry: a healing for what is in the breasts.
sudur = breasts / chests. Haleem hears heart.
SI: no change in the words of Allah. Haleem: there is no changing the promises of God. Pickthall: there is no changing the words of Allah. Arberry: no changing the words of God.
SI: Allah has taken a son. Haleem: God has offspring. Pickthall: Allah hath taken unto Himself a son. Arberry: God has taken to Him a son.
Haleem's 'offspring' is broader. Speakers unnamed here.
SI: the Free of need. Haleem: self-sufficient. Pickthall: the Absolute. Arberry: All-sufficient.
Rich / free of need. The antithesis of needing a son.
Yusuf Ali 10:68 line only: 'They say: Allah hath begotten a son! Glory be to Him! He is self-sufficient!'

The Recitation is named as admonition, breast-healing, guidance, mercy. Inventing ḥarām and ḥalāl without leave is a lie against God. Nothing of affair, recitation, or deed escapes witness; not a speck. Friends of God: no fear, no grief; God’s words are not substituted. Partners are conjecture and guessing. Taken-a-son is rejected: He is ghaniyy; you have no authority for the claim; saying what you do not know.

Christology dossier: 4:171, 5:17, 9:30. 6:101 / 2:116 parked cousins of taken-a-son. 10:15 baddilhu vs 10:64 lā tabdīla li-kalimāti llāh — same root family, different object. QB-0295 invented ḥalāl/ḥarām. QB-0296 10:68 generic son-charge; speakers unnamed. QB-0297 10:64 do not silently convert into muṣḥaf-stability.
Admonition, healing of breasts, guidance, mercy; rejoice in bounty
Provision split into haram and halal — leave or invention?
No affair, recitation, or deed unwitnessed; not a speck hidden
Friends of God: no fear, no grief; no changing God's words
Do not let their speech grieve you; the might is God's
They said God has taken a son; He is ghaniyy; no authority for this
10:71–93 — Noah, then Moses and Pharaoh, then the drowned; We delivered the Children of Israel.

packets.title: S010 Yunus CP05 vv071-093
paragraphs: Recite to them the news of Noah, when he said to his people: O my people, if my standing and my reminding you of God’s signs have become great upon you, then on God I have relied. So resolve your affair, you and your partners, then let not your affair be a grief upon you, then execute against me and do not give me respite. If you turn away, I have not asked you for a wage. My wage is only on God. I have been commanded to be of those who submit.
They denied him, so We delivered him and those with him in the ship, and We made them successors, and We drowned those who denied Our signs. See how the end of those who were warned was.
Then We sent after him messengers to their people. They came to them with the clear signs, but they were not to believe in what they had denied before. So We seal the hearts of the transgressors.

Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his assembly with Our signs. They grew proud and were a criminal people. When the truth came to them from Us they said: this is clear magic. Moses said: do you say of the truth when it has come to you — is this magic? Magicians do not prosper. They said: have you come to turn us from what we found our fathers upon, and that greatness in the land should be for you two? We are not believers in you.

Pharaoh said: bring me every knowing magician. When the magicians came, Moses said to them: throw what you will throw. When they threw, Moses said: what you have brought is magic. God will make it vain. God does not set right the work of the workers of corruption. God makes the truth true by His words, even if the criminals dislike it.

None believed in Moses except a progeny of his people, for fear of Pharaoh and his assembly, that he would put them to trial. Pharaoh was high in the land, and he was of the extravagant. Moses said: O my people, if you have believed in God, then on Him rely, if you have submitted. They said: on God we have relied. Our Lord, do not make us a trial for the wrongdoing people, and deliver us by Your mercy from the unbelieving people.

We revealed to Moses and his brother: settle your people in Egypt in houses, and make your houses a qibla, and establish the prayer, and give good news to the believers. Moses said: our Lord, You have given Pharaoh and his assembly adornment and wealth in this world’s life, our Lord, that they may lead astray from Your path. Our Lord, blot out their wealth and harden their hearts so that they will not believe until they see the painful punishment. He said: your prayer has been answered. So go straight, and do not follow the path of those who do not know.

We made the Children of Israel pass through the sea. Pharaoh and his hosts followed them in insolence and enmity, until when the drowning overtook him he said: I believe that there is no god but He in whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of those who submit. Now? And you had disobeyed before and you were of the workers of corruption. Today We will save you in your body that you may be a sign for those after you. Many of the people are heedless of Our signs. We settled the Children of Israel in a true settlement and provided them with good things. They did not differ until the knowledge came to them. Your Lord will decide between them on the Day of Rising in what they used to differ.

71–73 Noah: resolve and strike; no wage; denied; ship; successors; drowned. 74 messengers after him; hearts sealed. 75–82 Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh; truth called magic; magicians thrown; God makes magic vain; truth made true by His words. 83–86 only a progeny believed, in fear; rely if you have submitted; do not make us a trial. 87 houses in Egypt as qibla; pray; good news. 88–89 Moses’ prayer: blot wealth, harden hearts until they see the punishment — answered. 90–92 sea; Pharaoh’s late belief; body saved as a sign. 93 Israel settled; they differed after knowledge came.

Noah tells his people to resolve their affair with their partners and execute against him without respite. He asks no wage. They denied; he and those with him delivered in the ship; they made successors; the deniers drowned. Compact Noah panel: no ark-dimensions, no animals-by-twos, no rainbow in this stretch. Living snapshot vs Genesis 6–9: same namesake flood-deliverance; Quran here stresses the challenge-to-strike and the successor-status of the saved. Do not rebuild the full flood dossier in this packet.

Moses and Aaron sent with signs. Truth called magic. Magicians thrown; Moses: what you brought is magic; God will make it vain; God makes the truth true by His words. Cousin of the longer S007 magician-scene already walked. This telling is shorter: no staff-serpent detail in these verses, no magicians’ faith-reversal named here.
10:83–89 the fearful few and the answered prayer

None believed except a progeny of his people, for fear of Pharaoh. Houses in Egypt made a qibla — a direction / facing-point for prayer in the houses. Moses asks that wealth be blotted and hearts hardened until they see the painful punishment. The prayer is answered. Hardening-of-heart here is requested by Moses and granted. Exodus 4–11 hardening is attributed to YHWH across that file; this verse makes Moses the petitioner. Living snapshot, not a finished contrast.

Drowning overtakes him. He says: I believe there is no god but He in whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of those who submit. Rebuke: now? You disobeyed before. Today We save you in your body (nunajjīka bi-badanika) that you may be a sign for those after you. Exodus 14–15: the sea returns; Pharaoh’s host perishes; no verse saves Pharaoh’s corpse as a sign. This is a distinct Quranic beat. Do not invent a named mummy. The verse says body-as-sign.
Israel settled and provided. They did not differ until the knowledge came to them. Difference after knowledge is the charge. Lord will decide on the Rising-day.

nabāʾ Nūḥ. ʿazm. shurakāʾ. ajr. fulk. khalāʾif. ṭabaʿa. Mūsā / Hārūn. siḥr. asḥār. dhurriyyatin. qibla (houses). iṭmis. ušdud ʿalā qulūbihim. yamm. nunajjīka bi-badanika. būwwiʾnā. mā khtalafū ḥattā jāʾahumu l-ʿilm.
SI: make your houses [facing] the qiblah. Haleem: make your houses places of worship. Pickthall: make your houses oratories. Arberry: make your houses a direction for prayer.
qibla = facing-point. Haleem/Pickthall hear worship-place. Keep qibla.

SI: obliterate their wealth and harden their hearts. Haleem: wipe out their wealth and harden their hearts. Pickthall: destroy their wealth and harden their hearts. Arberry: obliterate their wealth, and harden their hearts.
SI: We will save you in body. Haleem: We shall save your body this day. Pickthall: We deliver thee (only) thy body. Arberry: We shall deliver thee with thy body.
Body saved as sign. Not 'we convert you'.
Yusuf Ali 10:92 line only: 'This day shall We save thee in the body, that thou mayest be a sign to those who come after thee!'

Noah asks no wage and dares them to strike. Denial, ship, successors, drowning. Later messengers meet sealed hearts. Moses and Aaron: truth called magic; God makes magic vain and makes truth true by His words. A fearful remnant believes. Houses in Egypt become a qibla. Moses’ prayer that wealth be blotted and hearts hardened is answered. Pharaoh’s late shahāda is refused; his body is saved as a sign. Israel settled; difference begins after knowledge arrives.

Genesis 6–9 flood (living). Exodus 7–15 magicians / sea (living). S007 magician-scene walked. 10:90–92 body-as-sign has no Exodus twin. QB-0298 Noah panel vs Gen 6–9 (compact). QB-0299 Moses petitions hardening. QB-0300 Pharaoh’s body saved as sign — Quranic beat.

Moses and Aaron; truth called magic; God makes magic vain

10:94–109 — if you are in doubt of what We sent down, ask those who read the Book before you; close of Yūnus.

packets.title: S010 Yunus CP06 vv094-109
paragraphs: If you are in doubt of what We have sent down to you, ask those who read the Book before you. The truth has come to you from your Lord. So do not be of the doubters. Do not be of those who deny God’s signs, so that you be of the losers.

Those against whom your Lord’s word has been realized will not believe, even if every sign came to them, until they see the painful punishment. Why was there not a town that believed and its faith benefited it, except the people of Jonah? When they believed We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in this world’s life, and We gave them enjoyment for a time.

If your Lord had willed, whoever is in the earth would have believed, all of them together. Will you then compel the people until they become believers? It is not for a soul to believe except by God’s leave. He places the filth on those who do not understand.

Say: look at what is in the heavens and the earth. Signs and warners do not avail a people who do not believe. Do they wait except the like of the days of those who passed before them? Say: wait. I am with you among those who wait. Then We deliver Our messengers and those who believed. Thus is it due on Us to deliver the believers.

Say: O people, if you are in doubt of my religion, I do not worship those you worship besides God. I worship God who takes you, and I have been commanded to be of the believers. And: set your face to the religion, ḥanīf, and do not be of the associators. Do not call besides God on what neither benefits you nor harms you. If you do, you are then of the wrongdoers. If God touches you with harm, none can remove it except He. If He wants good for you, none can turn back His bounty. He strikes with it whom He wills of His servants. He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

Say: O people, the truth has come to you from your Lord. Whoever is guided is guided only for himself. Whoever goes astray goes astray only against himself. I am not a trustee over you. Follow what is revealed to you, and be patient until God judges. He is the best of judges.

94–95 if you doubt what We sent down, ask those who read the Book before you; do not be of the doubters or deniers. 96–97 those whose word is realized will not believe until they see the punishment. 98 why no town believed except Jonah’s people — punishment lifted, enjoyment for a time. 99–100 if He willed all would believe; you cannot compel; no soul believes except by His leave. 101–103 look at heaven and earth; wait; We deliver messengers and believers. 104–107 if you doubt my religion: I do not worship what you worship; ḥanīf; nothing besides Him removes harm. 108–109 truth has come; guided for himself; I am not a wakīl; follow what is revealed; be patient until He judges.
10:94 ask those who read the Book before you

Fa-in kunta fī shakkin mimmā anzalnā ilayka fa-s’ali lladhīna yaqraʾūna l-kitāba min qablika. If you (singular) are in doubt of what We sent down to you, ask those who read the Book before you. The truth has come from your Lord; do not be of the doubters.

Address is second-person singular, on the face of it the Messenger. Later tafsīr often says ‘the doubter in general’ or ‘a rhetorical if.’ Level 1 is the sentence as written: doubt of what was sent down is to be checked with people who already read the Book. That only works if that Book is still readable. It sits on QCA-0001, 5:43–48, 5:68, 7:157, 9:111, 10:37. It is not the missing ‘they changed the book they possess’ sentence. It is the opposite pressure: go ask the readers.

Why was there not a town that believed so that its faith benefited it — except the people of Jonah? When they believed, the disgrace-punishment of this life was removed and they were given enjoyment for a time. The surah is named Yūnus; this is the only Jonah-panel in it, and it is the town’s repentance, not the fish. Jonah 3 is the cousin: Nineveh believed, disaster withheld. Living snapshot. Fish-panel is 21:87 / 37:139–148, still parked.

If your Lord had willed, all on earth would have believed together. Will you compel the people until they are believers? No soul believes except by God’s leave. He puts rijs on those who do not understand. Cousin of 2:256 parked-or-walked earlier. This verse is addressed into the Messenger’s zeal, not into a later legal code.

If you doubt my religion: I do not worship what you worship besides God. I worship the one who takes you. Face to the religion, ḥanīf; do not be of the associators. I am not a wakīl over you. Follow what is revealed to you. Be patient until God judges. Pole B again: follow revelation; you are not trustee over them; He judges.
shakk. yaqraʾūna l-kitāba min qablika. qawmi Yūnus. yukrihu. idhn Allāh. rijs. ḥanīf. wakīl. ḥattā yaḥkuma llāh.
10:94 fa-s'ali lladhina yaqra'una l-kitaba min qablika

SI: ask those who have been reading the Scripture before you. Haleem: ask those who read the Scripture before you. Pickthall: ask those who read the Scripture (that was) before thee. Arberry: question those who read the Book before thee.
Readers of the Book before you. Present-tense reading.
SI: the people of Jonah. Haleem: Jonah's people. Pickthall: the folk of Jonah. Arberry: the people of Jonah.
SI: would you compel the people. Haleem: can you force people. Pickthall: wouldst thou compel men. Arberry: wilt thou then constrain the people.
SI: inclining to truth. Haleem: as a man of pure faith. Pickthall: upright. Arberry: a man of pure faith.
Keep hanif. Walked since S002 / S006.
Yusuf Ali 10:94 line only: 'ask those who have been reading the Book from before thee.'

Doubt of what was sent down is sent to the readers of the prior Book. Jonah’s people are the exception-town whose faith lifted a this-world punishment. Faith is by God’s leave; the Messenger is asked whether he will compel. Signs in heaven and earth do not avail a people who will not believe. Deliverance of messengers and believers is due on God. Ḥanīf religion; no partner that can lift harm. He is not a trustee over them. Follow what is revealed. Wait for God’s judgment.
